newsitem.title: UK: UK SFA lifts special conditions on Salomon.
newsitem.headline: UK SFA lifts special conditions on Salomon.

text.p: Britain's securities industry regulator, the Securities and Futures Authority (SFA), on Wednesday lifted special conditions it imposed on Salomon Brothers International, a unit of Salomon Inc, last year.

The conditions were imposed in October 1995 and the SFA said at the time that they were, "designed to highlight any problems that arise in the reconciliation of general ledger accounts and to track the satisfactory resolution of those problems."
The SFA said last year that Salomon International had been in breach of the rules in that its control system had failed to keep pace with the expansion and complexity of the business.

The SFA added in its original statement, "Salomon has now corrected the problems that gave rise to the charge and SFA is satisfied (it) is now in compliance with the principles and the rules." -- London Newsroom +44 171 542 7717.
